V0613_28_00_06_0.text: I'll become stronger so that I can protect you instead!

V0613_29_00_00_0.text: I have to break this pattern of losing...

V0613_29_00_01_0.text: I can come back from this!

V0613_29_00_02_0.text: I'll reevaluate my tactics so I can come back stronger!

V0613_29_00_03_0.text:
You got me good.
But I promise I'll get you too!

V0613_29_00_06_0.text: He just proved that AIs and humans can work together!

V0613_29_00_05_0.text: You're as great at Dueling as you are at hacking, Ghost Gal.

V0613_33_00_01_0.text: This is the peak of my power!

V0613_30_00_00_0.text: Is that what you're calling me?

V0613_30_00_01_0.text: Thanks for looking out for me.

V0613_30_00_02_0.text: My priority is to save everyone I see!

V0613_34_00_00_0.text:

V0613_34_00_01_0.text: I owe you one. And I always repay my debts!

V0613_34_00_03_0.text: You were willing to take damage to get the monster you want.

V0613_34_00_05_0.text: There's nothing subtle about your Duel.

V0613_34_00_06_0.text: I can't read this Duelist at all...

V0613_34_00_09_0.text:
Sigh...
Such a waste of time.

V0613_34_00_10_0.text: This isn't the only card I have that can stop your Deck.

V0613_34_00_11_0.text: I wanted to help everyone, but I'm the one who needed help.

V0613_34_00_12_0.text:
None of us are really alone.
We can all help each other.

V0613_35_00_00_0.text: My usual look isn't a good fit when I'm on a secret mission.

V0613_35_00_01_0.text:

The name's Blue Gal.

V0613_36_00_00_0.text:
